# Facebook Reviews Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/facebook-reviews-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-reviews-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.365**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Extract data from hundreds of Facebook reviews from one or multiple Facebook pages. Get review text, timestamp, review URL, likes and comments count and basic reviewer info. Download the data in JSON, CSV, Excel and use it in apps, spreadsheets, and reports.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Review $0.0025, Actor start $0.001 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-reviews-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-facebook-reviews-scraper@0.0.365#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      startUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startUrls` | array | yes |  | Facebook URLs — Facebook Page reviews URL. Add one by one using Add+ or a whole prepared list using Text file button. |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | Number of results — If this limit is not set, as many results as possible will be scraped. |
| `onlyReviewsNewerThan` | string |  |  | 📅 Extract reviews that are newer than — Limit how far back to the history the scraper should go. The date should be in YYYY-MM-DD or full ISO absolute format or in relative format e.g. 1 year, 2 months, 3 days, 4 hours, or 5 minutes. All time values are taken in UTC timezone. |

## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `facebookUrl` | string \| null | URL of the Facebook page the reviews were scraped from. |
| `id` | string \| null | Internal numeric ID of the review. |
| `legacyId` | string \| null | Legacy numeric post ID of the review. |
| `user` | object \| null | User who wrote the review. |
| `date` | string \| null | Date and time the review was posted, in ISO 8601 format. |
| `url` | string \| null | Direct URL to the review. |
| `isRecommended` | boolean \| null | Whether the reviewer recommends the page. |
| `text` | string \| null | Text content of the review. |
| `tags` | array \| null | Tags attached to the review. |
| `likesCount` | number \| null | Number of likes the review received. |
| `photos` | array \| null | Photos attached to the review. |
| `commentsCount` | number \| null | Number of comments on the review. |
| `comments` | array \| null | Comments on the review. |
